How parents, carers and students can activate and access their Westview iGradePlus portal.
Westview creates the portal access first. Once your details have been added, iGradePlus sends an invitation or activation email with the next steps.
Give the school your name, your child’s full name and the email address you want linked to the parent portal.
School staff will add or update your parent portal details in iGradePlus.
Check your email for the iGradePlus invitation or activation message.
Follow the instructions in the email to activate your account, then use the Parent Login page.
Contact Westview Secondary School or ask the student to speak to the school office.
Provide the student’s full name, their parent or carer’s name and the email address that should be linked to the student account.
School staff will create or update the student portal access.
Check the email account for the iGradePlus invitation or activation instructions.
Follow the instructions to finish setup, then use the Student Login page.
If an invitation has not arrived, an email address needs changing, or the portal does not recognise the account, contact Westview first so the school can check the details linked to the account.

Westview is a community-focused secondary school built around high expectations, strong relationships and ambitious opportunities for every student.
We combine a calm, purposeful learning environment with strong pastoral care, enrichment and a broad curriculum.
Students, families, staff and local partners all play a part in making Westview safe, respectful and forward-looking.

We want every student to leave Westview confident, curious, kind and ready for what comes next.
Ambition — aiming high and improving every day.
Respect — treating people and places with care.
Responsibility — owning our choices and contributing positively.
Let your light shine. We use this to remind students that talent grows through effort, courage and opportunity.

Our curriculum is designed to build powerful knowledge, strong literacy and confident problem solving across every year group.
Students study a broad range of subjects including English, mathematics, science, humanities, languages, arts, technology and physical education.
Students continue a strong core alongside carefully chosen option subjects. Guidance is provided before options are selected.

Online spaces can be useful, creative and social, but students should know how to protect their privacy and respond to harmful content or contact.
Talk to a trusted adult when something feels wrong.
Families can support online safety by keeping conversations open, checking privacy settings and setting age-appropriate boundaries.
Clear information for students, families and our wider community.
Bullying is not accepted at Westview. Reports are taken seriously and staff work to stop harmful behaviour and support students affected.
Students can tell a tutor, Head of Year, teacher or another trusted adult. Families can contact the school directly.
Staff will listen, gather information, take appropriate action and keep the situation under review.

Grief can affect people in different ways and at different times. Our pastoral team will work sensitively with students and families following a bereavement.
Support may include a trusted adult, time out, temporary adjustments and help managing schoolwork while a student is grieving.
